name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the Mayor
pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may be submitted by email at
publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 10:00 a.m. on the date of the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL – SITE TOUR

  MEETING PLACE: METRO RIGHT-OF-WAY AT 187th ST. AND CORBY AVE.
  SITE TOUR: 187th ST. AND CORBY AVE. TO 183rd & GRIDLEY
  (AKA HISTORICAL DISTRICT WALKING OR RECREATIONAL TRAIL)
  ARTESIA, CA 90701

  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 27, 2023
  1:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Members of the public are invited to participate in the site tour at the
locations listed above. If a member of the public cannot find the tour at any time, please call (562)
865-6262, and you will be connected to reception, who will provide you with real-time information
as to the tour’s exact location. You may provide public comment and input during the special
meeting.

SITE TOUR

  1. HISTORICAL DISTRICT WALKING TRAIL

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.

ARTESIACITY COUNCIL  SPECIAL  - SITE TOUR MEETING  MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY,  DECEMBER  27, 2023, 1:00 P.M.

CALL  TO ORDER
Mayor  Lima called  the meeting  to order  at I :02 p.m.

ROLL  CALL
Present:  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem Taj, Councilmembers
  Lima,  Trevino, and Ramoso
Absent:  Councilmember  Manalo, who abstained  from the meeting, due to potential  conflict  of
interest
Staff Present: City Manager  Schindler,  Deputy  City Manager  Burke,  City Attorney  Nguyen,  City
Engineer  Ron Ibarra

PUBLIC  COMMENTS
Public comments could  be provided  for items  listed on the special  agenda,  in person  or submitted
by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us  by 10:00 a.m. on the date of the meeting. Bill Zystra
and Nick Brown  provided  public  comments

SITE TOUR
The site tour of the Historical  District  Walking  Trail commenced.

COUNCILMEMBER  COMMENTS
Mayor Lima, Mayor Pro Tem Taj, Councilmembers  Trevino,  and Ramoso  asked  questions
and/or provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT
The meeting adjourned  at 1:50  p.m.
